display.name: Example automation
display.description: Reads the document a run was given, extracts its fields with a model, holds large amounts for approval, records the result and emails the outcome.

input.title: Reference
input.description: The document's own reference, as printed on it.

input.title: Document
input.description: A file already uploaded for this run. The model reads it; a run may start without one.

requiredConnections.purpose: Records each extracted document in your account.

setup.title: Hold above
setup.description: Documents whose amount is above this wait for someone to approve them. Editable anytime.

setup.title: Email the outcome to
setup.description: Where each decided document is reported. Left empty, no email is sent. Sent from automations@autom8x.ai, never your own mailbox.

pipeline.title: Document received
pipeline.description: A run is started with a reference and, optionally, the document to read.

pipeline.title: Extract the fields
pipeline.description: Asks the platform's model for the vendor and the amount, held to a schema.

pipeline.title: Check the amount
pipeline.description: Compares the amount against your threshold and holds it if it is above.

pipeline.title: Record the document
pipeline.description: Records the extracted document in your connected account.

pipeline.title: Email the outcome
pipeline.description: Emails the decision from automations@autom8x.ai, when an address is set.
